zh:
- 同步 GitHub 首页的中英文 README，明确当前线上应用为 v2.8.1，补齐更新动态修正的说明，并提供最新源码发布入口。
- 同步维护与部署文档中的已完成状态，记录实际运行版本和回退基线。
- 将相关中英文文档、发布说明、帮助摘要和部署状态随更新一并维护写入项目规则，无需用户逐项提醒。

本版仅更新文档和项目规则；线上应用仍为 v2.8.1，不修改运行文件或重新部署 Space。
en:
- Synchronize both GitHub homepage READMEs with the deployed v2.8.1 application, include the release-highlight correction and link to the latest source release.
- Update maintenance and deployment documentation with completed status, the actual running version and rollback baseline.
- Add project instructions to maintain affected bilingual documentation, release notes, Help highlights and deployment status together without separate user reminders.

This release changes documentation and project instructions only. The deployed application remains v2.8.1; runtime files and the Space deployment are unchanged.
documentation_zh: 已核对根 README、应用/Space README、帮助页摘要、RELEASES、HANDOFF、DEPLOYMENT、ARCHITECTURE、DESIGN 和 AGENTS。更新根 README、版本历史、维护与部署文档的中英文内容，新增根 AGENTS.md 统一同步要求。应用/Space README 和帮助摘要已对应 v2.8.1；架构、配置、界面和应用目录规则未变，保留原样；历史审查记录不改写。
documentation_en: Reviewed the root and application/Space READMEs, Help highlights, RELEASES, HANDOFF, DEPLOYMENT, ARCHITECTURE, DESIGN and AGENTS. Updated both root READMEs, version history, maintenance and deployment guides, and added root AGENTS.md synchronization instructions. The application/Space README and Help highlights already match v2.8.1. Architecture, configuration, UI and application-directory rules are unchanged; historical reviews remain intact.
